component.name: Icon
component.description: Reusable action icon component used as a swappable leading icon inside Action List Item. Icons are graphical component variants, not text glyphs.

antiPatterns.scenario: Replacing the row title with an icon-only label
antiPatterns.reason: The Action List row must remain understandable from text.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use icon as decorative/supporting context and keep action_title visible.

contentRules: Glifos duotono desde Figma (pagina Icons, node 141:896); viewBox 38×38; colores via semantic/icon/duo/a|b|badge.
Mapeo API name → Figma: microchip; medicalDocument (59:1493); injection (59:1513); care (59:1519); notifications (141:962); notificationsBadge (141:963); present (141:964).
Use icons to reinforce the action type, not to encode priority alone.
Priority remains communicated by Chip / Priority text.
Icons use semantic/icon/duo/* tokens via CSS classes; prop `tone` adjusts duo variables.
Use `size` sm | md | lg for 24, 38, 48 px (layout/icon/size/*).

rules: Icon / Action variants are composed as instances inside Action List Item leading slot.
Do not use raw text glyphs for the leading icon in Action List Item.

Default size `md` (38px) for Card icon wells; Action List uses **sm** (24px) + **secondary** tone for leading icons by default (override per row with `iconSize` / `iconTone`); use `lg` (48px) when the container is 48px.

accessibility.role: presentation unless the icon adds non-repeated information
accessibility.keyboardSupport: Not interactive; parent row handles focus.
accessibility.screenReader: Do not announce decorative icons; row title and chip carry the accessible name.

aiHints.context: Use Icon / Action for Action List leading visuals. Swap the component variant rather than drawing or typing an icon locally.
